_comment: Precedence is command line > preset > environment variable > built-in default, so
anything typed on the command line still wins. Paths resolve against THIS file's
directory, not the cwd. _comment keys are ignored; anything else unknown is refused

qwen3-vl-2b._comment: The 2B fp16 artifact the README's numbers come from. context-length is the checkpoint's max_position_embeddings (262144); max-kv auto takes that capped by the device memory budget (the server prints the result and the CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS to start the client with). kv-cache makes a restart skip the re-prefill.

qwen3-vl-2b-image._comment: The 2B LLM plus Qwen-Image behind POST /v1/images/generations (OpenAI Images shape). One GPU queue for both; with the default memory budget (70% of RAM) the two do not fit together on a 36 GB machine, so whichever ran less recently is unloaded first -- the LLM process exits (writing its kv-cache file) and relaunches warm on its next request, the image process drops its graphs but keeps its per-prompt cache.

qwen3-vl-2b-fp8kv._comment: Same model, e4m3 KV cache: half the bytes per row, so max-kv auto fits twice the rows. Needs the fp8 variant artifact (llm/exporter/make_kv_variant.py --fp8), not just this preset -- if it is not built the server says 'missing:' and stops.

qwen3-vl-2b-short._comment: Short-prompt benchmarking: a wide chunk is ~2x faster, but only while q x covered rows stays clear of the device-lost wall (see README). kv-cache is empty on purpose, so presets do not share one file across window sizes.
